document_api_meta.title: Review Aftersales Requests
document_api_meta.env_desc: API used to review (approve, reject, or offer alternatives to) a buyer's return request.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: aftersales_request_decisions
request_body_param.desc: Decisions to apply to aftersales requests.

request_body_param.name: ^request_id
request_body_param.desc: Identifies the object upon which this decision is made.

request_body_param.name: ^request_id_type
request_body_param.desc:
Type of identifier provided in request_id.
Possible values:
- `AFTERSALES`
- `RMA`

request_body_param.name: ^line_item_decisions
request_body_param.desc:
Decisions applied at the line item level.
One SKU may only have one decision, so all line items (corresponding to that same SKU) should fall under the same decision object.
Different line item decisions for the same SKU will soon be supported in the future.

request_body_param.name: ^^line_items
request_body_param.desc: Line items for which this decision applies. Decision details apply to each line item individually (e.g. a partial refund amount of $1.00 for 3 line items will result in a total partial refund amount of $3.00).

request_body_param.name: ^^^return_line_item_id
request_body_param.desc: Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the original parent item bundle.

request_body_param.name: ^^^sub_return_line_item_id
request_body_param.desc: Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the current child item being returned.

request_body_param.name: ^^action
request_body_param.desc:
Action/decision to be applied.
Possible values:
- `APPROVE_REQUEST`
- `APPROVE_RETURN_PACKAGE`
- `REJECT_REQUEST`
- `REJECT_RETURN_PACKAGE`
- `REFUND_INSTEAD`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`

request_body_param.name: ^^alternative_solution_details
request_body_param.desc: Details for an alternative resolution (if applicable).

request_body_param.name: ^^^currency
request_body_param.desc: Currency of the refund amount (ISO 4217). Must match the currency of the forward order.

request_body_param.name: ^^reason
request_body_param.desc: To justify the action/decision (generally required for rejection).

request_body_param.name: ^^^reason_id
request_body_param.desc:
Seller's reason for rejecting the aftersales request. Use the [Get Review Decision](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-review-decision-202606) endpoint to retrieve the currently available rejection options for the same request, and submit the returned rejection reason name in this field.
**Note**: The available decisions and rejection reasons can change depending on the current request status, so fetch eligibility again before calling this API.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^uri
request_body_param.desc: Image URI obtained from the [Upload Product Image](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509df95defece02be598a22) API.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^mime_type
request_body_param.desc: MIME type of the media (such as image/jpeg).

request_body_param.name: ^action_unix_time
request_body_param.desc: The timestamp at which the decision/action was made (in unix seconds).

request_body_param.name: ^idempotency_key
request_body_param.desc: The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize the same request. How you create unique keys is up to you, but we suggest using UUIDs, or another random string with enough entropy to avoid collisions. Idempotency keys can be up to 255 characters long.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^errors
response_param.desc:
Lists errors for partially failed requests. For example, if a request reviews multiple orders or items and only some fail, individual error details are returned here.

**IMPORTANT**: Partial failures still return a top-level success code (0), so clients must also check this field to detect partial errors. For complete failures (e.g. validation errors), the top-level response code and message will indicate a failure, but this field will remain empty.
